type_text:
∀ (n : ℕ) {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
  (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
  (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n) (j : Fin n)
  (hex :
    ∃ k,
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.uncovered labels
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer k).remaining
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer k).pending j =
        []),
  ¬Nat.find hex = 0 → ∀ a ≤ Nat.find hex - 1, ¬a < Nat.find hex → False
